name: ZnS sphalerite
citation: B. J. Skinner. Unit-cell edges of natural and synthetic sphalerites. American Mineralogist 46 (1961), 1399-1411.
recommendation: recommended first-round source candidate; FEFF validation pending
method: Experimental X-ray unit-cell-edge study; the selected pure ZnS reference uses the measured cubic lattice edge and symmetry-fixed zincblende coordinates, not an independent free-coordinate refinement.
notes: Pure synthetic ZnS endmember. COD1525302 was rejected because it contains mixed Fe/Mn/Zn occupancies.
25 degrees Celsius is the temperature associated with the selected pure ZnS lattice edge, not a synthesis temperature.
No DOI verified in the COD record, raw CIF, or primary journal citation; primary article URL retained.
Atomic positions are fixed by zincblende symmetry; publication measures cell edges.
The source CIF has no atom occupancy column; parser treats sites as fully occupied. This is not an explicit occupancy measurement.
Pressure is not numerically specified in the inspected source; leave measurement_pressure_GPa null.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Original paper introduction identifies the pure ZnS lattice edge 5.4093 +/- 0.0002 angstrom at 25 degrees Celsius; same edge appears in COD9000107.

license.database_policy: COD dedicates its data/database to the public domain under CC0; retain original article attribution and original file notice.
license.original_file_notice: CIF header identifies AMCSD as original data provider and requests proper attribution to the journal article.
